items.title: Chico Hamilton — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: And that’s when everybody was on the band, Tricky Sam, Johnny -- you know all them guys.

ctx.x: Empire. I got up there man, and started sweeping and Jimmy Blanton was down in front, looked up at me and said yeah, you know. And that’s when everybody was on the band, Tricky Sam, Johnny -- you know all them guys. That was it. I stayed there -- oh, I must have played about a couple, two or three weeks until Sonny got well.
I know you weren’t nervous. You already told me you don’t get nervous.
